tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, taken live for real customer bookings during internship at Sunflower Trip.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across the platform.
Designed a full-stack trading platform across three services: marketing site, trading dashboard, and Express API with JWT-based authentication using httpOnly cookies.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team, I am writing to apply for the Backend Intern (NodeJs) position at Ventura Securities Ltd. As an MCA student at PES University with practical experience in backend development using Node.js and Express, I am eager to contribute to your fintech team building scalable solutions. During my professional internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Node.js, Express, Angular, and MySQL, implementing secure authentication and role-based access control. Additionally, in my Zenvest project, I developed an Express API with JWT-based authentication, Joi request validation, and server-side proxy integration, deploying services across Vercel, Render, and MongoDB Atlas. I also bring foundational cloud exposure with AWS and Azure. I am confident that my practical backend experience with Node.js and JavaScript aligns well with the requirements for this 6-month full-time internship. Thank you for your time and consideration. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed

screening_answers.why_this_company: Ventura Securities is establishing its fintech team as a remote-first, work from anywhere team with talented individuals solving real client problems at scale, backed by 20 years in the stockbroking business as a robust and profitable franchise.
screening_answers.why_this_role: The role focuses on Node.js and AWS, which directly aligns with my hands-on experience building backend APIs and web applications using Node.js, Express, and cloud deployment tools during my MCA studies and professional internships.
screening_answers.why_you: I bring hands-on backend development experience using Node.js, Express, and JavaScript from my internship at Sunflower Trip and projects like Zenvest, where I implemented JWT authentication and REST APIs.
